banking-economy.title: Mufin Green Finance gets RBI licence to offer forex, remittance services
banking-economy.summary: Mufin Green Finance has recently received an AD-II licence from the RBI, permitting it to offer forex services. The company's recent financial results indicate significant growth in profit and income.
